rules_text:
0 Petals In Petals, you'll have to create an enchanting garden where you'll combine Elemental Flowers while trying to maintain a delicate balance. You'll have to earn points on four different Elemental Trackers. And you'll have to do so in a balanced way because... winning doesn't always mean victory. Each Petals card contains parts of four Elemental Flowers of different colors, and each Flower contains a different number. On your turn, you will have two cards in your hand to choose which one to play, along with any cards already on the table. Your goal will be to match numbers, colors, or both, and thus score points on each of the four Elemental Trackers, while a beautiful garden forms before your eyes. In addition, some cards contain Elemental Symbols, which will allow you to score higher or even reposition a card that is already on the table to score again. Lastly, you must have the highest score in at least one of the four Trackers, but you will only win if you have maintained balance in all of them. Petals is a beautiful, simple, and challenging game. Each card is unique, and every game will be one of a kind. Number of players: 1 - 5 Game duration: 12 mn Complexity: 1 / 5 Play Petals and 1414 other games online. community_text:
[Rating: 6/10] I like the Knizia-style scoring, not sure how I feel about the randomness of the card draw

[Rating: 9/10] El jardín de Petals está repleto de preciosas Flores Elementales, pero debes ordenarlas estratégicamente para conservar el equilibrio entre los cuatro Elementos.  Haz coincidir números y Flores Elementales para cosechar puntos en los Marcadores Elementales y la victoria florecerá ante tus ojos.

[Rating: 9/10] Definitivamente siempre disfruto jugando a Petals. Lo único que necesito para mejorar la experiencia es una versión deluxe con un tablero de puntuación más grande. Por lo demás, este abstracto tiene un diseño inteligente que funciona como un reloj y que genera una sensación constante de reto y superación.

[Rating: 10/10] Un juego que nos encantó desde que lo vimos y lo pudimos probar. Muy agradable de ver en mesa y de mecánica  muy interesante ya que debes mantener el equilibrio entre las 4 puntuaciones de colores de pétalos. Y el modo solitario es todo un acierto.
